title: Analysis of Methylesterase Gene Family in Fragaria vesca Unveils Novel Insights into the Role of FvMES2 in Methyl Salicylate-Mediated Resistance against Strawberry Gray Mold.
authors: Jia, Ruimin; Xing, Keyan; Tian, Lin; Dong, Xiaomin; Yu, Ligang; Shen, Xihui; Wang, Yang
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究草莓甲酯酶基因家族及FvMES2在抗病中的作用，仅含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Methylesterases (MESs) hydrolyze carboxylic ester and are important for plant metabolism and defense. However, the understanding of MES' role in strawberries against pathogens remains limited. This study identified 15 FvMESs with a conserved catalytic triad from the Fragaria vesca genome. Spatiotemporal expression data demonstrated the upregulated expression of FvMESs in roots and developing fruits, suggesting growth involvement. The FvMES promoter regions harbored numerous stress-related cis-acting elements and transcription factors associated with plant defense mechanisms. Moreover, FvMES2 exhibited a significant response to Botrytis cinerea stress and showed a remarkable correlation with the salicylic acid (SA) signaling pathway. Molecular docking showed an efficient binding potential between FvMES2 and methyl salicylate (MeSA). The role of FvMES2 in MeSA demethylation to produce SA was further confirmed through in vitro and in vivo assays. After MeSA was applied, the transient overexpression of FvMES2 in strawberries enhanced their resistance to B. cinerea compared to wild-type plants.
abstract_zh: 甲酯酶（MESs）水解羧酸酯，对植物代谢和防御至关重要。然而，关于MES在草莓中抵抗病原体作用的理解仍然有限。本研究从森林草莓（Fragaria vesca）基因组中鉴定出15个具有保守催化三联体的FvMESs。时空表达数据显示，FvMESs在根部和发育中的果实中表达上调，提示其参与生长过程。FvMES启动子区域含有大量与植物防御机制相关的应激响应顺式作用元件和转录因子。此外，FvMES2对灰葡萄孢（Botrytis cinerea）胁迫表现出显著响应，并与水杨酸（SA）信号通路显示出显著相关性。分子对接显示FvMES2与水杨酸甲酯（MeSA）之间存在高效结合潜力。通过体外和体内实验进一步证实了FvMES2在MeSA去甲基化生成SA中的作用。施用MeSA后，与野生型植株相比，草莓中FvMES2的瞬时过表达增强了其对灰葡萄孢的抗性。
